# test_order_fulfillment.py
import pytest
from testcontainers.kafka import KafkaContainer
from testcontainers.postgres import PostgresContainer

@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def kafka():
    with KafkaContainer() as k:
        yield k.get_bootstrap_server()

@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def databases():
    """Isolation critical. Each service, own database."""
    with PostgresContainer() as order_db, \
         PostgresContainer() as inventory_db, \
         PostgresContainer() as payment_db:
        yield {"order": order_db, "inventory": inventory_db, "payment": payment_db}

@pytest.fixture
def test_order(databases):
    """Fresh data each test. No contamination."""
    order = create_test_order(sku="TEST-001", qty=5)
    seed_inventory(databases["inventory"], sku="TEST-001", available=10)
    yield order
    # Cleanup automatic. Transaction rollback.

# HAPPY PATH
class TestCompleteOrderFlow:
    def test_order_to_notification(self, kafka, databases, test_order):
        """Name: End-to-end success
        Steps: Submit order → verify each stage
        Assertions: Final state confirmed, notification sent"""
        result = submit_order(test_order)
        
        assert_eventually(lambda: get_order_status(result.id) == "CONFIRMED")
        assert_inventory_decremented(test_order.sku, by=test_order.qty)
        assert_payment_captured(result.payment_id)
        assert_notification_sent(result.id, type="ORDER_CONFIRMED")

# SERVICE FAILURES - each permutation
class TestInventoryFailure:
    def test_insufficient_stock_triggers_rejection(self, test_order):
        """Inventory unavailable. Order rejected. No payment attempted."""
        seed_inventory(sku=test_order.sku, available=0)
        
        result = submit_order(test_order)
        
        assert result.status == "REJECTED"
        assert_no_payment_attempted(test_order.id)

class TestPaymentFailure:
    def test_payment_decline_unreserves_inventory(self, test_order):
        """Payment fails. Compensation required. Inventory restored."""
        mock_payment_service(decline=True)
        original_stock = get_inventory(test_order.sku)
        
        submit_order(test_order)
        
        assert_eventually(lambda: get_inventory(test_order.sku) == original_stock)
        assert_order_status(test_order.id, "PAYMENT_FAILED")

# TIMEOUT/RETRY
class TestResiliency:
    def test_inventory_timeout_retries_then_fails(self, test_order):
        """Three attempts. Exponential backoff. Then graceful failure."""
        mock_inventory_service(timeout_count=3)
        
        with assert_retries(expected=3, backoff="exponential"):
            result = submit_order(test_order)
        
        assert result.status == "SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE"

# ASYNC MESSAGE HANDLING
class TestMessageOrdering:
    def test_out_of_order_messages_handled(self, kafka, test_order):
        """Messages arrive wrong order. System compensates."""
        publish_event("PaymentConfirmed", order_id=test_order.id)
        publish_event("InventoryReserved", order_id=test_order.id)  # Late
        
        assert_eventually(lambda: get_order_status(test_order.id) == "CONFIRMED")
